subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?

subject: Heads of Research Evening with Luc Vincent | CVPR'25 | 14 June
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw Latitude has a booth at CVPR this year - if you're attending, I'd
love to extend an invite to our event on Saturday (6/14) evening. It'll be
hosted by [SENDER] our Head of ML for Heads of Research/ Applied
Science attending the conference.

We're opening the evening with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent (Chief R&D
Officer at Nexar, former CTO of Hayden AI, VP at Woven & Lyft) as he
reflects on his career and the toughest challenges still facing teams
scaling computer vision models today.

We hope the evening can be a valuable occasion to connect so we intend the
conversations to carry over the dinner joined by Heads of AI from Siemens,
Bosch ADAS, Porsche, etc.

Hope to see you in Nashville - let me know if you can drop by?

subject: CVPR Connect
text:
Hi [NAME],

I thought there will be a good chance you'll be at CVPR this year - and if
so, I'd love to introduce myself in person. We've been working on projects
w/ Nexar, Motive, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robotics, 1X and Figure AI etc.
developing models for use cases like pick 'n' pack warehouse automation - I
hope we can find time to connect.

A bit of context on Encord - we help 200+ AI teams label data 2x-10x faster
than in-house or first gen tools, resulting in shorter model iteration
cycles & improved model performance. We do this by offering an integrated
platform for data curation, annotation and model evaluation.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives of the
automotive/robotics space? We'll be at the conference Friday (6/13) to
Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to find a time that suits you!

Assuming you and the [COMPANY] team might be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev.

We'll be at the conference so let me know when works best for you and I can get it booked in! Feel free to swing by our booth (#1123) as well.
